hints.title: Convex Hull Boundary Envelope
hints.text: The fence is the convex hull enclosing all points, including all collinear points along the boundary.

hints.title: 2D Cross Product Orientation
hints.text: For points p, q, and r, compute cross product (q[0] - p[0]) * (r[1] - p[1]) - (q[1] - p[1]) * (r[0] - p[0]). Negative cross product denotes strict right turn.

hints.title: Monotone Chain Graham Scan
hints.text: Sort trees by x then y. Build lower hull by keeping collinear points (pop while cross product < 0). Build upper hull by iterating backwards with the same rule. Combine and deduplicate points.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of tree coordinate points
complexity.notes: Monotone chain convex hull with collinear point preservation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Gift wrapping Jarvis march runs in O(N * H) which degrades on degenerate collinear shapes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting points executes in O(N log N) with linear hull stack traversal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use Monotone Chain convex hull retaining cross product == 0 collinear points.
